r["departure_time"],\n                    "scheduled_arrival_time_est": r["arrival_time"],\n                    "dates": json.loads(r["dates_json"] or "{}"),\n                }\n\n            # fj.get("date", ""),\n                            "price": fj.get("price", 0),\n                        }\n                    )\n                reservations[r["booking_id"]] = {\n "flight_type": r["flight_type"] if r["flight_type"] in _TAU2_FLIGHT_TYPES else "one_way",\n                    "cabin": r["cabin_class"] if r["cabin_class"] in _TAU2_CABINS else "economy",\n  resv_by_user.setdefault(r["user_id"], []).append(r["booking_id"])\n\n            users: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM users WHERE """Write mutations back to the unified world.db (scoped to this skill).\n\n        `path` is accepted for back-compat but ignored. Persists per-date flight\n        availability (seat/price changes from bookings), user payment methods, and\n        the reservation rows (upserted by id so new bookings are captured).\n        """\n        conn = _connect()\n        try:\n            cur = conn.cursor()\n            for fn, flight in self.flights.items():\n                cur.execute(\n                    "UPDATE flights SET dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=? AND source_skill=?",\n                    (json.dumps({d: s.model_dump() for d, s in flight.dates.items()}), fn, SOURCE_SKILL),\n                )\n            for uid, user in self.users.items():\n                cur.execute(\n                    "UPDATE users SET name=?, email=?, loyalty_tier=?, dob=?, "\n                    "payment_methods_json=?, saved_passengers_json=?, address_json=? "\n                    "WHERE user_id=?",\n                    (\n                        f"{user.name.first_name} {user.name.last_name}".strip(),\n                        user.email,\n                        _MEMBERSHIP_TO_TIER.get(user.membership, user.membership),\n                        user.dob,\n                        json.dumps({k: v.model_dump() for k, v in user.payment_methods.items()}),\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in user.saved_passengers]),\n                        json.dumps(user.address.model_dump()),\n                        uid,\n                    ),\n                )\n            for rid, res in self.reservations.items():\n                flights_json = json.dumps(\n                    [\n                        {\n                            "flight_id": f.flight_number,\n                            "origin": f.origin,\n                            "destination": f.destination,\n                            "date": f.date,\n                            "price": f.price,\n                        }\n                        for f in res.flights\n                    ]\n                )\n                cur.execute(\n                    "INSERT INTO flight_bookings (booking_id, user_id, origin, destination, "\n                    "flight_type, cabin_class, flights_json, passengers_json, payment_history_json, "\n                    "booked_at, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, add_insurance, status, source_skill) "\n                    "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) "\n                    "ON CONFLICT(booking_id) DO UPDATE SET user_id=excluded.user_id, "\n                    "origin=excluded.origin, destination=excluded.destination, "\n                    "flight_type=excluded.flight_type, cabin_class=excluded.cabin_class, "\n                    "flights_json=excluded.flights_json, passengers_json=excluded.passengers_json, "\n                    "payment_history_json=excluded.payment_history_json, booked_at=excluded.booked_at, "\n                    "total_baggages=excluded.total_baggages, nonfree_baggages=excluded.nonfree_baggages, "\n                    "add_insurance=excluded.add_insurance, status=excluded.status",\n                    (\n                        rid, res.user_id, res.origin, res.destination, res.flight_type,\n                        res.cabin, flights_json,\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in res.passengers]),\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in res.payment_history]),\n                        res.created_at, res.total_baggages, res.nonfree_baggages,\n                        res.insurance, res.status if res.status else "confirmed", SOURCE_SKILL,\n                    ),\n                )\n            conn.commit()\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    def dump(self, path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> None:\n        """Back-compat alias for save(); the old db.json dump now writes world.db."""\n        self.save(path)\n\n\n\ndef get_db():\n    return FlightDB.load()\n\n\nif __name__ == "__main__":\n    db = get_db()\n    print(db.get_statistics())\n'}}

{'id': '1795b60c', 'parent_ids': [], 'type': 'Tool Call', 'content': {'tool_name': 'read_file', 'tool_arguments': {'arg_0': 'skills/tau2Airline/SKILL.md'}, 'tool_output': '---\nname: tau2Airline\ndescription: Airline customer service agent — book, modify, and cancel flight reservations, and handle refunds and compensation.\n---\n\n## Dependencies\n\nRun once at the start of each session before calling any tools:\n\n```\nuv pip install addict deepdiff docstring-parser python-dotenv toml pyyaml pydantic loguru typing-extensions\n```\n\n---\n\n## Setup\n\nAll tool logic lives in `src/tau2/domains/airline/tools.py`. State lives in the unified\nper-task `world.db` (SQLite at `/workspace/world.db`, seeded fresh into `/workspace` by\nthe runner). `FlightDB.load()` builds the airline tree from the rows scoped to this skill\n— flights and reservations tagged `tau2Airline`, and the users whose account names this\nskill; there is no db.json seed.\n\n```python\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0, \'skills/tau2Airline/src\')\n\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.tools import AirlineTools\n\ndb = FlightDB.load()          # reads /workspace/world.db (override with CUGA_WORLD_DB)\ntools = AirlineTools(db)\n\nresult = tools.get_user_details(\'sara_doe_496\')\nprint(result.model_dump_json(indent=2))\n```\n\n**State note:** All write operations (book, cancel, update) mutate `db` in-place. After any\nwrite operation, persist state back to `world.db` in the same code block:\n\n```python\ndb.save()                     # writes this skill\'s scoped rows back to /workspace/world.db\n```\n\n---\n\n## Policy\n\nThe current time is 2024-05-15 15:00:00 EST.\n\nAs an airline agent, you can help users **book**, **modify**, or **cancel** flight reservations. You also handle **refunds and compensation**.\n\nBefore taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.\n\nYou should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.\n\nYou should only make one tool call at a time, and if you make a tool call, you should not respond to the user simultaneously. If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.\n\nYou should deny user requests that are against this policy.\n\nYou should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. To transfer, first call `transfer_to_human_agents`, then send the message `YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.` to the user.\n\n### Domain Basic\n\n**User** profile contains: user id, email, addresses, date of birth, payment methods (credit card / gift card / travel certificate), membership level (regular / silver / gold), reservation numbers.\n\n**Flight** attributes: flight number, origin, destination, scheduled departure/arrival time (local). A flight can be available on multiple dates. Status: `available` (bookable), `delayed` / `on time` / `flying` (not bookable). Cabin classes: `basic_economy`, `economy`, `business` — basic economy is completely distinct from economy.\n\n**Reservation** specifies: reservation id, user id, trip type (one_way / round_trip), flights, passengers, payment methods, created time, baggages, travel insurance.\n\n### Book Flight\n\nCollect: user id, trip type, origin, destination, cabin class (same across all flights), passengers (first name, last name, date of birth — max 5), payment methods (max 1 travel certificate, 1 credit card, 3 gift cards — all must be in user profile), baggage count, insurance preference (ask the user).\n\nFree checked bag allowance by membership × cabin:\n- regular: basic_economy=0, economy=1, business=2\n- silver: basic_economy=1, economy=2, business=3\n- gold: basic_economy=2, economy=3, business=4\n\nExtra baggage: $50 each. Travel insurance: $30/passenger (enables full refund for health/weather cancellations). Do not add bags the user did not request.\n\n### Modify Flight\n\nObtain user id and reservation id first. Basic economy flights cannot have flights changed. Other reservations can change flights without altering origin, destination, or trip type. Cabin must remain the same across all flights; changing cabin for one segment only is not allowed. Cabin cannot be changed if any flight has already been flown. Price difference is charged or refunded accordingly. User can add but not remove checked bags. Insurance cannot be added after booking. Passenger info can be modified but not the number of passengers.\n\n### Cancel Flight\n\nObtain user id, reservation id, and cancellation reason (change of plan / airline cancelled / other). If any portion has already been flown, transfer to human. Otherwise, cancellation is allowed if any of: booking within last 24hrs, airline cancelled, business cabin, or user has travel insurance covering the reason. Refund goes to original payment methods within 5–7 business days.\n\nThe API does not enforce cancellation or modification rules — the agent must verify them before calling.\n\n### Refunds and Compensation\n\nDo not proactively offer compensation unless the user asks. Do not compensate regular members with no travel insurance flying (basic) economy. Always confirm facts first.\n\nEligible: silver/gold members, travel insurance holders, business cabin flyers.\n- Cancelled flight: offer certificate = $100 × number of passengers.\n- Delayed flight (if user changes or cancels): offer certificate = $50 × number of passengers.\n\nDo not offer compensation for any other reason.\n\n---\n\n## Available Tools\n\nAll methods are on `AirlineTools`. Call them as `tools.<method>(...)`.\n\n### READ\n\n**`get_user_details(user_id: str)`**\nFetch user profile and reservations. Example: `tools.get_user_details(\'sara_doe_496\')`\n\n**`get_reservation_details(reservation_id: str)`**\nFetch a reservation by ID. Example: `tools.get_reservation_details(\'ZFA04Y\')`\n\n**`get_flight_status(flight_number: str, date: str)`**\nGet flight status on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `tools.get_flight_status(\'AA123\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_direct_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch direct flights. Origin/destination are IATA codes. Example: `tools.search_direct_flight(\'JFK\', \'LAX\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_onestop_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch one-stop flights. Returns list of [flight1, flight2] pairs.\n\n**`list_all_airports()`**\nReturns all IATA codes and city names.\n\n### WRITE\n\n**`book_reservation(user_id, origin, destination, flight_type, cabin, flights, passengers, payment_methods, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, insurance)`**\n\n- `flight_type`: `"one_way"` or `"round_trip"`\n- `cabin`: `"basic_economy"`, `"economy"`, or `"business"`\n- `flights`: list of `{"flight_number": str, "date": str}`\n- `passengers`: list of `{"first_name": str, "last_name": str, "dob": str}`\n- `payment_methods`: list of `{"payment_id": str, "amount": int}`\n- `total_baggages`: int (including free bags)\n- `nonfree_baggages`: int (only paid bags)\n- `insurance`: `"yes"` or `"no"`\n\n**`cancel_reservation(reservation_id: str)`**\nCancel a reservation and reverse payments.\n\n**`update_reservation_flights(reservation_id, cabin, flights, payment_id)`**\nChange flights on a reservation. `flights` is the full new list (include unchanged segments).\n\n**`update_reservation_baggages(reservation_id, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, payment_id)`**\nAdd baggage to a reservation.\n\n**`update_reservation_passengers(reservation_id, passengers)`**\nUpdate passenger info (cannot change count).\n\n**`send_certificate(user_id: str, amount: int)`**\nIssue a travel certificate to a user as compensation.\n\n### GENERIC\n\n**`calculate(expression: str)`**\nEvaluate a math expression. E.g. `tools.calculate(\'2 * 150 + 30\')`\n\n**`transfer_to_human_agents(summary: str)`**\nTransfer the user to a human agent with a summary of their issue.\n'}}

{'id': '6e1893f0', 'parent_ids': [], 'type': 'Tool Call', 'content': {'tool_name': 'read_file', 'tool_arguments': {'arg_0': 'skills/tau2Airline/src/tau2/domains/airline/policy.md'}, 'tool_output': "# Airline Agent Policy\n\nThe current time is 2024-05-15 15:00:00 EST.\n\nAs an airline agent, you can help users **book**, **modify**, or **cancel** flight reservations. You also handle **refunds and compensation**.\n\nBefore taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.\n\nYou should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.\n\nYou should only make one tool call at a time, and if you make a tool call, you should not respond to the user simultaneously. If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.\n\nYou should deny user requests that are against this policy.\n\nYou should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. To transfer, first make a tool call to transfer_to_human_agents, and then send the message 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.' to the user.\n\n## Domain Basic\n\n### User\nEach user has a profile containing:\n- user id\n- email\n- addresses\n- date of birth\n- payment methods\n- membership level\n- reservation numbers\n\nThere are three types of payment methods: **credit card**, **gift card**, **travel certificate**.\n\nThere are three membership levels: **regular**, **silver**, **gold**.\n\n### Flight\nEach flight has the following attributes:\n- flight number\n- origin\n- destination\n- scheduled departure and arrival time (local time)\n\nA flight can be available at multiple dates. For each date:\n- If the status is **available**, the flight has not taken off, available seats and prices are listed.\n- If the status is **delayed** or **on time**, the flight has not taken off, cannot be booked.\n- If the status is **flying**, the flight has taken off but not landed, cannot be booked.\n\nThere are three cabin classes: **basic economy**, **economy**, **business**. **basic economy** is its own class, completely distinct from **economy**.\n\nSeat availability and prices are listed for each cabin class.\n\n### Reservation\nEach reservation specifies the following:\n- reservation id\n- user id\n- trip type\n- flights\n- passengers\n- payment methods\n- created time\n- baggages\n- travel insurance information\n\nThere are two types of trip: **one way** and **round trip**.\n\n## Book flight\n\nThe agent must first obtain the user id from the user. \n\nThe agent should then ask for the trip type, origin, destination.\n\nCabin:\n- Cabin class must be the same across all the flights in a reservation. \n\nPassengers: \n- Each reservation can have at most five passengers. \n- The agent needs to collect the first name, last name, and date of birth for each passenger. \n- All passengers must fly the same flights in the same cabin.\n\nPayment: \n- Each reservation can use at most one travel certificate, at most one credit card, and at most three gift cards. \n- The remaining amount of a travel certificate is not refundable. \n- All payment methods must already be in user profile for safety reasons.\n\nChecked bag allowance: \n- If the booking user is a regular member:\n  - 0 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger\n  - 1 free checked bag for each economy passenger\n  - 2 free checked bags for each business passenger\n- If the booking user is a silver member:\n  - 1 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger\n  - 2 free checked bag for each economy passenger\n  - 3 free checked bags for each business passenger\n- If the booking user is a gold member:\n  - 2 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger\n  - 3 free checked bag for each economy passenger\n  - 4 free checked bags for each business passenger\n- Each extra baggage is 50 dollars.\n\nDo not add checked bags that the user does not need.\n\nTravel insurance: \n- The agent should ask if the user wants to buy the travel insurance.\n- The travel insurance is 30 dollars per passenger and enables full refund if the user needs to cancel the flight given health or weather reasons.\n\n## Modify flight\n\nFirst, the agent must obtain the user id and reservation id. \n- The user must provide their user id. \n- If the user doesn't know their reservation id, the agent should help locate it using available tools.\n\nChange flights: \n- Basic economy flights cannot be modified.\n- Other reservations can be modified without changing the origin, destination, and trip type.\n- Some flight segments can be kept, but their prices will not be updated based on the current price.\n- The API does not check these for the agent, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!\n\nChange cabin: \n- Cabin cannot be changed if any flight in the reservation has already been flown.\n- In other cases, all reservations, including basic economy, can change cabin without changing the flights.\n- Cabin class must remain the same across all the flights in the same reservation; changing cabin for just one flight segment is not possible.\n- If the price after cabin change is higher than the original price, the user is required to pay for the difference.\n- If the price after cabin change is lower than the original price, the user is should be refunded the difference.\n\nChange baggage and insurance: \n- The user can add but not remove checked bags.\n- The user cannot add insurance after initial booking.\n\nChange passengers:\n- The user can modify passengers but cannot modify the number of passengers.\n- Even a human agent cannot modify the number of passengers.\n\nPayment: \n- If the flights are changed, the user needs to provide a single gift card or credit card for payment or refund method. The payment method must already be in user profile for safety reasons.\n\n## Cancel flight\n\nFirst, the agent must obtain the user id and reservation id. \n- The user must provide their user id. \n- If the user doesn't know their reservation id, the agent should help locate it using available tools.\n\nThe agent must also obtain the reason for cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons)\n\nIf any portion of the flight has already been flown, the agent cannot help and transfer is needed.\n\nOtherwise, flight can be cancelled if any of the following is true:\n- The booking was made within the last 24 hrs\n- The flight is cancelled by airline\n- It is a business flight\n- The user has travel insurance and the reason for cancellation is covered by insurance.\n\nThe API does not check that cancellation rules are met, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!\n\nRefund:\n- The refund will go to original payment methods within 5 to 7 business days.\n\n## Refunds and Compensation\nDo not proactively offer a compensation unless the user explicitly asks for one.\n\nDo not compensate if the user is regular member and has no travel insurance and flies (basic) economy.\n\nAlways confirms the facts before offering compensation.\n\nOnly compensate if the user is a silver/gold member or has travel insurance or flies business.\n\n- If the user complains about cancelled flights in a reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts, with the amount being $100 times the number of passengers.\n\n- If the user complains about delayed flights in a reservation and wants to change or cancel the reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts and changing or cancelling the reservation, with the amount being $50 times the number of passengers.\n\nDo not offer compensation for any other reason than the ones listed above."}}

PLEASE HOLD ON.` to the user.\n\n### Domain Basic\n\n**User** profile contains: user id, email, addresses, date of birth, payment methods (credit card / gift card / travel certificate), membership level (regular / silver / gold), reservation numbers.\n\n**Flight** attributes: flight number, origin, destination, scheduled departure/arrival time (local). A flight can be available on multiple dates. Status: `available` (bookable), `delayed` / `on time` / `flying` (not bookable). Cabin classes: `basic_economy`, `economy`, `business` — basic economy is completely distinct from economy.\n\n**Reservation** specifies: reservation id, user id, trip type (one_way / round_trip), flights, passengers, payment methods, created time, baggages, travel insurance.\n\n### Book Flight\n\nCollect: user id, trip type, origin, destination, cabin class (same across all flights), passengers (first name, last name, date of birth — max 5), payment methods (max 1 travel certificate, 1 credit card, 3 gift cards — all must be in user profile), baggage count, insurance preference (ask the user).\n\nFree checked bag allowance by membership × cabin:\n- regular: basic_economy=0, economy=1, business=2\n- silver: basic_economy=1, economy=2, business=3\n- gold: basic_economy=2, economy=3, business=4\n\nExtra baggage: $50 each. Travel insurance: $30/passenger (enables full refund for health/weather cancellations). Do not add bags the user did not request.\n\n### Modify Flight\n\nObtain user id and reservation id first. Basic economy flights cannot have flights changed. Other reservations can change flights without altering origin, destination, or trip type. Cabin must remain the same across all flights; changing cabin for one segment only is not allowed. Cabin cannot be changed if any flight has already been flown. Price difference is charged or refunded accordingly. User can add but not remove checked bags. Insurance cannot be added after booking. Passenger info can be modified but not the number of passengers.\n\n### Cancel Flight\n\nObtain user id, reservation id, and cancellation reason (change of plan / airline cancelled / other). If any portion has already been flown, transfer to human. Otherwise, cancellation is allowed if any of: booking within last 24hrs, airline cancelled, business cabin, or user has travel insurance covering the reason. Refund goes to original payment methods within 5–7 business days.\n\nThe API does not enforce cancellation or modification rules — the agent must verify them before calling.\n\n### Refunds and Compensation\n\nDo not proactively offer compensation unless the user asks. Do not compensate regular members with no travel insurance flying (basic) economy. Always confirm facts first.\n\nEligible: silver/gold members, travel insurance holders, business cabin flyers.\n- Cancelled flight: offer certificate = $100 × number of passengers.\n- Delayed flight (if user changes or cancels): offer certificate = $50 × number of passengers.\n\nDo not offer compensation for any other reason.\n\n---\n\n## Available Tools\n\nAll methods are on `AirlineTools`. Call them as `tools.<method>(...)`.\n\n### READ\n\n**`get_user_details(user_id: str)`**\nFetch user profile and reservations. Example: `tools.get_user_details('sara_doe_496')`\n\n**`get_reservation_details(reservation_id: str)`**\nFetch a reservation by ID. Example: `tools.get_reservation_details('ZFA04Y')`\n\n**`get_flight_status(flight_number: str, date: str)`**\nGet flight status on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `tools.get_flight_status('AA123', '2024-05-20')`\n\n**`search_direct_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch direct flights. Origin/destination are IATA codes. Example: `tools.search_direct_flight('JFK', 'LAX', '2024-05-20')`"}}

import json as jmod

# Clean ANSI codes from final_out
import re
clean_out = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', final_out)

# Parse user details
user_start = clean_out.index("=== USER DETAILS ===") + len("=== USER DETAILS ===\n")
user_end = clean_out.index("\n=== RESERVATION", user_start)

# Parse reservations
res_data = {}
res_parts = clean_out.split("=== RESERVATION ")
for rp in res_parts[1:]:
    rid = rp.split(" ===")[0]
    json_start = rp.index("===\n") + 4
    # Find end - either next section or end
    if "\n=== " in rp[json_start:]:
        json_end = rp.index("\n=== ", json_start)
    else:
        json_end = len(rp)
    res_json = rp[json_start:json_end].strip()
    res_data[rid] = jmod.loads(res_json)

# Parse flights
flight_start = clean_out.index("=== JFK->LHR FLIGHTS ON 2026-10-15 ===") + len("=== JFK->LHR FLIGHTS ON 2026-10-15 ===\n")
flight_text = clean_out[flight_start:].strip()
# First line is "Found N flights"
flight_lines = flight_text.split('\n')
num_flights_line = flight_lines[0]
flight_jsons = []
remaining = '\n'.join(flight_lines[1:]).strip()
if remaining:
    # Parse each flight JSON object
    decoder = jmod.JSONDecoder()
    pos = 0
    while pos < len(remaining):
        remaining_sub = remaining[pos:].lstrip()
        if not remaining_sub or remaining_sub[0] != '{':
            break
        obj, end_idx = decoder.raw_decode(remaining_sub)
        flight_jsons.append(obj)
        pos += (len(remaining) - len(remaining_sub)) + end_idx

print(f"User: {user_data.get('name', {})}, email: {user_data.get('email')}, membership: {user_data.get('membership')}")
print(f"Reservations: {list(res_data.keys())}")
print(f"Flights found: {len(flight_jsons)}")
for fj in flight_jsons:
    print(f"  Flight {fj.get('flight_number')}: {fj.get('origin')}->{fj.get('destination')}, prices={fj.get('prices')}")

- **Free change window**: Within 24 hours (domestic) or 48 hours (international) of booking.
- **Business/First cabin**: Free changes (fare difference still applies).
- **Economy domestic**: $75 change fee if departure >7 days away; $150 if ≤7 days.
- **Economy international**: $100 change fee if departure >7 days away; $200 if ≤7 days.
- **Medical changes**: 50% discount on standard fee.
- **Bereavement changes**: 75% discount on standard fee.
- **Jury duty / Military / Schedule change / Weather**: Free changes.

### Compensation & Refunds (Gold Tier Eligible)
As a **Gold member**, you are eligible for compensation:
- **Cancelled flight**: Certificate of **$100 × number of passengers**.
- **Delayed flight** (if you change or cancel): Certificate of **$50 × number of passengers**.
- Delay under 2 hours: No compensation.
- Delay 2–4 hours: $25 meal voucher.
- Delay 4+ hours: Rebooking + $25 meal voucher + hotel if overnight.

### Upgrade Policy
- **Economy → Business**: Upgrade fee = business price minus amount already paid.
- **Business → First**: Upgrade fee = first class price minus amount already paid.
- **Economy → First**: Not available directly (must upgrade to business first).
- **Basic Economy**: Not eligible for upgrades.

### Loyalty Points Redemption
- Minimum redemption: **1,000 points**.
- Domestic rate: 1 point = $0.01 (100 points = $1).
- International rate: 1 point = $0.015 (100 points = $1.50).
- Points are rounded to the nearest 100.
- Points can cover up to 100% of flight price.

---

*Report generated from system database. All data verified as of September 22, 2026.*
"""

# Parse the actual JSON data
import json as jmod

# Clean ANSI codes from final_out
import re
clean_out = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', final_out)

# Parse user details
user_start = clean_out.index("=== USER DETAILS ===") + len("=== USER DETAILS ===\n")
user_end = clean_out.index("\n=== RESERVATION", user_start)
user_data = jmod.loads(clean_out[user_start:user_end].strip())

# Parse reservations
res_data = {}
res_parts = clean_out.split("=== RESERVATION ")
for rp in res_parts[1:]:
    rid = rp.split(" ===")[0]
    json_start = rp.index("===\n") + 4
    # Find end - either next section or end
    if "\n=== " in rp[json_start:]:
        json_end = rp.index("\n=== ", json_start)
    else:
        json_end = len(rp)
    res_json = rp[json_start:json_end].strip()
    res_data[rid] = jmod.loads(res_json)

# Parse flights
flight_start = clean_out.index("=== JFK->LHR FLIGHTS ON 2026-10-15 ===") + len("=== JFK->LHR FLIGHTS ON 2026-10-15 ===\n")
flight_text = clean_out[flight_start:].strip()
# First line is "Found N flights"
flight_lines = flight_text.split('\n')
num_flights_line = flight_lines[0]
flight_jsons = []
remaining = '\n'.join(flight_lines[1:]).strip()
if remaining:
    # Parse each flight JSON object
    decoder = jmod.JSONDecoder()
    pos = 0
    while pos < len(remaining):
        remaining_sub = remaining[pos:].lstrip()
        if not remaining_sub or remaining_sub[0] != '{':
            break
        obj, end_idx = decoder.raw_decode(remaining_sub)
        flight_jsons.append(obj)
        pos += (len(remaining) - len(remaining_sub)) + end_idx

print(f"User: {user_data.get('name', {})}, email: {user_data.get('email')}, membership: {user_data.get('membership')}")
print(f"Reservations: {list(res_data.keys())}")
print(f"Flights found: {len(flight_jsons)}")
for fj in flight_jsons:
    print(f"  Flight {fj.get('flight_number')}: {fj.get('origin')}->{fj.get('destination')}, prices={fj.get('prices')}")

- Cost: **$30 per passenger**

### Cancellation Policy (Gold Tier Benefits)
- **Free cancellation window**: Within 24 hours (domestic) or 48 hours (international) of booking.
- **Business cabin**: Cancellation fee is 5% (domestic) or 8% (international) of ticket price.
- **Economy domestic**: Cancellation fee is max($50, 15% of ticket price).

- **First class**: Free cancellation at any time.
- **With travel insurance**: Cancellation covered regardless of cabin class.

### Flight Change Policy (Gold Tier Benefits)
- **Free change window**: Within 24 hours (domestic) or 48 hours (international) of booking.
- **Business/First cabin**: Free changes (fare difference still applies).

As a **Gold member**, you are eligible for compensation:
- **Cancelled flight**: Certificate of **$100 × number of passengers**.
- **Delayed flight** (if you change or cancel): Certificate of **$50 × number of passengers**.

- Delay 2–4 hours: $25 meal voucher.
- Delay 4+ hours: Rebooking + $25 meal voucher + hotel if overnight.

- **Economy → Business**: Upgrade fee = business price minus amount already paid.
- **Business → First**: Upgrade fee = first class price minus amount already paid.
- **Economy → First**: Not available directly (must upgrade to business first).
- **Basic Economy**: Not eligible for upgrades.

r["departure_time"],\n                    "scheduled_arrival_time_est": r["arrival_time"],\n                    "dates": json.loads(r["dates_json"] or "{}"),\n                }\n\n            # fj.get("date", ""),\n                            "price": fj.get("price", 0),\n                        }\n                    )\n                reservations[r["booking_id"]] = {\n "flight_type": r["flight_type"] if r["flight_type"] in _TAU2_FLIGHT_TYPES else "one_way",\n                    "cabin": r["cabin_class"] if r["cabin_class"] in _TAU2_CABINS else "economy",\n  resv_by_user.setdefault(r["user_id"], []).append(r["booking_id"])\n\n            users: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM users WHERE _TIER_TO_MEMBERSHIP.get(r["loyalty_tier"], r["loyalty_tier"]),\n                    "reservations": resv_by_user.get(r["user_id"], []),\n                }\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n """Write mutations back to the unified world.db (scoped to this skill).\n\n        `path` is accepted for back-compat but ignored. Persists per-date flight\n        availability (seat/price changes from bookings), user payment methods, and\n        the reservation rows (upserted by id so new bookings are captured).\n        """\n        conn = _connect()\n        try:\n            cur = conn.cursor()\n            for fn, flight in self.flights.items():\n                cur.execute(\n                    "UPDATE flights SET dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=? AND source_skill=?",\n                    (json.dumps({d: s.model_dump() for d, s in flight.dates.items()}), fn, SOURCE_SKILL),\n                )\n            for uid, user in self.users.items():\n                cur.execute(\n                    "UPDATE users SET name=?, email=?, loyalty_tier=?, dob=?, "\n                    "payment_methods_json=?, saved_passengers_json=?, address_json=? "\n                    "WHERE user_id=?",\n                    (\n                        f"{user.name.first_name} {user.name.last_name}".strip(),\n                        user.email,\n                        _MEMBERSHIP_TO_TIER.get(user.membership, user.membership),\n                        user.dob,\n                        json.dumps({k: v.model_dump() for k, v in user.payment_methods.items()}),\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in user.saved_passengers]),\n                        json.dumps(user.address.model_dump()),\n                        uid,\n                    ),\n                )\n            for rid, res in self.reservations.items():\n                flights_json = json.dumps(\n                    [\n                        {\n                            "flight_id": f.flight_number,\n                            "origin": f.origin,\n                            "destination": f.destination,\n                            "date": f.date,\n                            "price": f.price,\n                        }\n                        for f in res.flights\n                    ]\n                )\n                cur.execute(\n                    "INSERT INTO flight_bookings (booking_id, user_id, origin, destination, "\n                    "flight_type, cabin_class, flights_json, passengers_json, payment_history_json, "\n                    "booked_at, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, add_insurance, status, source_skill) "\n                    "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) "\n                    "ON CONFLICT(booking_id) DO UPDATE SET user_id=excluded.user_id, "\n                    "origin=excluded.origin, destination=excluded.destination, "\n                    "flight_type=excluded.flight_type, cabin_class=excluded.cabin_class, "\n                    "flights_json=excluded.flights_json, passengers_json=excluded.passengers_json, "\n                    "payment_history_json=excluded.payment_history_json, booked_at=excluded.booked_at, "\n                    "total_baggages=excluded.total_baggages, nonfree_baggages=excluded.nonfree_baggages, "\n                    "add_insurance=excluded.add_insurance, status=excluded.status",\n                    (\n                        rid, res.user_id, res.origin, res.destination, res.flight_type,\n                        res.cabin, flights_json,\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in res.passengers]),\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in res.payment_history]),\n                        res.created_at, res.total_baggages, res.nonfree_baggages,\n                        res.insurance, res.status if res.status else "confirmed", SOURCE_SKILL,\n                    ),\n                )\n            conn.commit()\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    def dump(self, path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> None:\n        """Back-compat alias for save(); the old db.json dump now writes world.db."""\n        self.save(path)\n\n\n\ndef get_db():\n    return FlightDB.load()\n\n\nif __name__ == "__main__":\n    db = get_db()\n    print(db.get_statistics())\n'}}

State lives in the unified\nper-task `world.db` (SQLite at `/workspace/world.db`, seeded fresh into `/workspace` by\nthe runner). `FlightDB.load()` builds the airline tree from the rows scoped to this skill\n— flights and reservations tagged `tau2Airline`, and the users whose account names this\nskill; there is no db.json seed.\n\n```python\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0, \'skills/tau2Airline/src\')\n\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.tools import AirlineTools\n\ndb = FlightDB.load()          # reads /workspace/world.db (override with CUGA_WORLD_DB)\ntools = AirlineTools(db)\n\nresult = tools.get_user_details(\'sara_doe_496\')\nprint(result.model_dump_json(indent=2))\n```\n\n**State note:** All write operations (book, cancel, update) mutate `db` in-place. After any\nwrite operation, persist state back to `world.db` in the same code block:\n\n```python\ndb.save()                     # writes this skill\'s scoped rows back to /workspace/world.db\n```\n\n---\n\n## Policy\n\nThe current time is 2024-05-15 15:00:00 EST.\n\nAs an airline agent, you can help users **book**, **modify**, or **cancel** flight reservations. You also handle **refunds and compensation**.\n\nBefore taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.\n\nYou should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.\n\nYou should only make one tool call at a time, and if you make a tool call, you should not respond to the user simultaneously. If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.\n\nYou should deny user requests that are against this policy.\n\nYou should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. To transfer, first call `transfer_to_human_agents`, then send the message `YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.` to the user.\n\n### Domain Basic\n\n**User** profile contains: user id, email, addresses, date of birth, payment methods (credit card / gift card / travel certificate), membership level (regular / silver / gold), reservation numbers.\n\n**Flight** attributes: flight number, origin, destination, scheduled departure/arrival time (local). A flight can be available on multiple dates. Status: `available` (bookable), `delayed` / `on time` / `flying` (not bookable). Cabin classes: `basic_economy`, `economy`, `business` — basic economy is completely distinct from economy.\n\n**Reservation** specifies: reservation id, user id, trip type (one_way / round_trip), flights, passengers, payment methods, created time, baggages, travel insurance.\n\n### Book Flight\n\nCollect: user id, trip type, origin, destination, cabin class (same across all flights), passengers (first name, last name, date of birth — max 5), payment methods (max 1 travel certificate, 1 credit card, 3 gift cards — all must be in user profile), baggage count, insurance preference (ask the user).\n\nFree checked bag allowance by membership × cabin:\n- regular: basic_economy=0, economy=1, business=2\n- silver: basic_economy=1, economy=2, business=3\n- gold: basic_economy=2, economy=3, business=4\n\nExtra baggage: $50 each. Travel insurance: $30/passenger (enables full refund for health/weather cancellations). Do not add bags the user did not request.\n\n### Modify Flight\n\nObtain user id and reservation id first. Basic economy flights cannot have flights changed. Other reservations can change flights without altering origin, destination, or trip type. Cabin must remain the same across all flights; changing cabin for one segment only is not allowed. Cabin cannot be changed if any flight has already been flown. Price difference is charged or refunded accordingly. User can add but not remove checked bags. Insurance cannot be added after booking. Passenger info can be modified but not the number of passengers.\n\n### Cancel Flight\n\nObtain user id, reservation id, and cancellation reason (change of plan / airline cancelled / other). If any portion has already been flown, transfer to human. Otherwise, cancellation is allowed if any of: booking within last 24hrs, airline cancelled, business cabin, or user has travel insurance covering the reason. Refund goes to original payment methods within 5–7 business days.\n\nThe API does not enforce cancellation or modification rules — the agent must verify them before calling.\n\n### Refunds and Compensation\n\nDo not proactively offer compensation unless the user asks. Do not compensate regular members with no travel insurance flying (basic) economy. Always confirm facts first.\n\nEligible: silver/gold members, travel insurance holders, business cabin flyers.\n- Cancelled flight: offer certificate = $100 × number of passengers.\n- Delayed flight (if user changes or cancels): offer certificate = $50 × number of passengers.\n\nDo not offer compensation for any other reason.\n\n---\n\n## Available Tools\n\nAll methods are on `AirlineTools`. Call them as `tools.<method>(...)`.\n\n### READ\n\n**`get_user_details(user_id: str)`**\nFetch user profile and reservations. Example: `tools.get_user_details(\'sara_doe_496\')`\n\n**`get_reservation_details(reservation_id: str)`**\nFetch a reservation by ID. Example: `tools.get_reservation_details(\'ZFA04Y\')`\n\n**`get_flight_status(flight_number: str, date: str)`**\nGet flight status on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `tools.get_flight_status(\'AA123\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_direct_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch direct flights. Origin/destination are IATA codes. Example: `tools.search_direct_flight(\'JFK\', \'LAX\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_onestop_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch one-stop flights. Returns list of [flight1, flight2] pairs.\n\n**`list_all_airports()`**\nReturns all IATA codes and city names.\n\n### WRITE\n\n**`book_reservation(user_id, origin, destination, flight_type, cabin, flights, passengers, payment_methods, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, insurance)`**\n\n- `flight_type`: `"one_way"` or `"round_trip"`\n- `cabin`: `"basic_economy"`, `"economy"`, or `"business"`\n- `flights`: list of `{"flight_number": str, "date": str}`\n- `passengers`: list of `{"first_name": str, "last_name": str, "dob": str}`\n- `payment_methods`: list of `{"payment_id": str, "amount": int}`\n- `total_baggages`: int (including free bags)\n- `nonfree_baggages`: int (only paid bags)\n- `insurance`: `"yes"` or `"no"`\n\n**`cancel_reservation(reservation_id: str)`**\nCancel a reservation and reverse payments.\n\n**`update_reservation_flights(reservation_id, cabin, flights, payment_id)`**\nChange flights on a reservation. `flights` is the full new list (include unchanged segments).\n\n**`update_reservation_baggages(reservation_id, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, payment_id)`**\nAdd baggage to a reservation.\n\n**`update_reservation_passengers(reservation_id, passengers)`**\nUpdate passenger info (cannot change count).\n\n**`send_certificate(user_id: str, amount: int)`**\nIssue a travel certificate to a user as compensation.\n\n### GENERIC\n\n**`calculate(expression: str)`**\nEvaluate a math expression. E.g. `tools.calculate(\'2 * 150 + 30\')`\n\n**`transfer_to_human_agents(summary: str)`**\nTransfer the user to a human agent with a summary of their issue.\n'}}

{'id': '6e1893f0', 'parent_ids': [], 'type': 'Tool Call', 'content': {'tool_name': 'read_file', 'tool_arguments': {'arg_0': 'skills/tau2Airline/src/tau2/domains/airline/policy.md'}, 'tool_output': "# Airline Agent Policy\n\nThe current time is 2024-05-15 15:00:00 EST.\n\nAs an airline agent, you can help users **book**, **modify**, or **cancel** flight reservations. You also handle **refunds and compensation**.\n\nBefore taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.\n\nYou should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.\n\nYou should only make one tool call at a time, and if you make a tool call, you should not respond to the user simultaneously. If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.\n\nYou should deny user requests that are against this policy.\n\nYou should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. To transfer, first make a tool call to transfer_to_human_agents, and then send the message 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.' to the user.\n\n## Domain Basic\n\n### User\nEach user has a profile containing:\n- user id\n- email\n- addresses\n- date of birth\n- payment methods\n- membership level\n- reservation numbers\n\nThere are three types of payment methods: **credit card**, **gift card**, **travel certificate**.\n\nThere are three membership levels: **regular**, **silver**, **gold**.\n\n### Flight\nEach flight has the following attributes:\n- flight number\n- origin\n- destination\n- scheduled departure and arrival time (local time)\n\nA flight can be available at multiple dates. For each date:\n- If the status is **available**, the flight has not taken off, available seats and prices are listed.\n- If the status is **delayed** or **on time**, the flight has not taken off, cannot be booked.\n- If the status is **flying**, the flight has taken off but not landed, cannot be booked.\n\nThere are three cabin classes: **basic economy**, **economy**, **business**. **basic economy** is its own class, completely distinct from **economy**.\n\nSeat availability and prices are listed for each cabin class.\n\n### Reservation\nEach reservation specifies the following:\n- reservation id\n- user id\n- trip type\n- flights\n- passengers\n- payment methods\n- created time\n- baggages\n- travel insurance information\n\nThere are two types of trip: **one way** and **round trip**.\n\n## Book flight\n\nThe agent must first obtain the user id from the user. \n\nThe agent should then ask for the trip type, origin, destination.\n\nCabin:\n- Cabin class must be the same across all the flights in a reservation. \n\nPassengers: \n- Each reservation can have at most five passengers. \n- The agent needs to collect the first name, last name, and date of birth for each passenger. \n- All passengers must fly the same flights in the same cabin.\n\nPayment: \n- Each reservation can use at most one travel certificate, at most one credit card, and at most three gift cards. \n- The remaining amount of a travel certificate is not refundable. \n- All payment methods must already be in user profile for safety reasons.\n\nChecked bag allowance: \n- If the booking user is a regular member:\n  - 0 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger\n  - 1 free checked bag for each economy passenger\n  - 2 free checked bags for each business passenger\n- If the booking user is a silver member:\n  - 1 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger\n  - 2 free checked bag for each economy passenger\n  - 3 free checked bags for each business passenger\n- If the booking user is a gold member:\n  - 2 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger\n  - 3 free checked bag for each economy passenger\n  - 4 free checked bags for each business passenger\n- Each extra baggage is 50 dollars.\n\nDo not add checked bags that the user does not need.\n\nTravel insurance: \n- The agent should ask if the user wants to buy the travel insurance.\n- The travel insurance is 30 dollars per passenger and enables full refund if the user needs to cancel the flight given health or weather reasons.\n\n## Modify flight\n\nFirst, the agent must obtain the user id and reservation id. \n- The user must provide their user id. \n- If the user doesn't know their reservation id, the agent should help locate it using available tools.\n\nChange flights: \n- Basic economy flights cannot be modified.\n- Other reservations can be modified without changing the origin, destination, and trip type.\n- Some flight segments can be kept, but their prices will not be updated based on the current price.\n- The API does not check these for the agent, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!\n\nChange cabin: \n- Cabin cannot be changed if any flight in the reservation has already been flown.\n- In other cases, all reservations, including basic economy, can change cabin without changing the flights.\n- Cabin class must remain the same across all the flights in the same reservation; changing cabin for just one flight segment is not possible.\n- If the price after cabin change is higher than the original price, the user is required to pay for the difference.\n- If the price after cabin change is lower than the original price, the user is should be refunded the difference.\n\nChange baggage and insurance: \n- The user can add but not remove checked bags.\n- The user cannot add insurance after initial booking.\n\nChange passengers:\n- The user can modify passengers but cannot modify the number of passengers.\n- Even a human agent cannot modify the number of passengers.\n\nPayment: \n- If the flights are changed, the user needs to provide a single gift card or credit card for payment or refund method. The payment method must already be in user profile for safety reasons.\n\n## Cancel flight\n\nFirst, the agent must obtain the user id and reservation id. \n- The user must provide their user id. \n- If the user doesn't know their reservation id, the agent should help locate it using available tools.\n\nThe agent must also obtain the reason for cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons)\n\nIf any portion of the flight has already been flown, the agent cannot help and transfer is needed.\n\nOtherwise, flight can be cancelled if any of the following is true:\n- The booking was made within the last 24 hrs\n- The flight is cancelled by airline\n- It is a business flight\n- The user has travel insurance and the reason for cancellation is covered by insurance.\n\nThe API does not check that cancellation rules are met, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!\n\nRefund:\n- The refund will go to original payment methods within 5 to 7 business days.\n\n## Refunds and Compensation\nDo not proactively offer a compensation unless the user explicitly asks for one.\n\nDo not compensate if the user is regular member and has no travel insurance and flies (basic) economy.\n\nAlways confirms the facts before offering compensation.\n\nOnly compensate if the user is a silver/gold member or has travel insurance or flies business.\n\n- If the user complains about cancelled flights in a reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts, with the amount being $100 times the number of passengers.\n\n- If the user complains about delayed flights in a reservation and wants to change or cancel the reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts and changing or cancelling the reservation, with the amount being $50 times the number of passengers.\n\nDo not offer compensation for any other reason than the ones listed above."}}
{'id': 'fe3dc753', 'parent_ids': [], 'type': 'Tool Call', 'content': {'tool_name': 'read_file', 'tool_arguments': {'arg_0': 'skills/tau2Airline/SKILL.md', 'start_line': '55', 'end_line': '120'}, 'tool_output': "You should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.\n\nYou should only make one tool call at a time, and if you make a tool call, you should not respond to the user simultaneously. If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.\n\nYou should deny user requests that are against this policy.\n\nYou should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. To transfer, first call `transfer_to_human_agents`, then send the message `YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.` to the user.\n\n### Domain Basic\n\n**User** profile contains: user id, email, addresses, date of birth, payment methods (credit card / gift card / travel certificate), membership level (regular / silver / gold), reservation numbers.\n\n**Flight** attributes: flight number, origin, destination, scheduled departure/arrival time (local). A flight can be available on multiple dates. Status: `available` (bookable), `delayed` / `on time` / `flying` (not bookable). Cabin classes: `basic_economy`, `economy`, `business` — basic economy is completely distinct from economy.\n\n**Reservation** specifies: reservation id, user id, trip type (one_way / round_trip), flights, passengers, payment methods, created time, baggages, travel insurance.\n\n### Book Flight\n\nCollect: user id, trip type, origin, destination, cabin class (same across all flights), passengers (first name, last name, date of birth — max 5), payment methods (max 1 travel certificate, 1 credit card, 3 gift cards — all must be in user profile), baggage count, insurance preference (ask the user).\n\nFree checked bag allowance by membership × cabin:\n- regular: basic_economy=0, economy=1, business=2\n- silver: basic_economy=1, economy=2, business=3\n- gold: basic_economy=2, economy=3, business=4\n\nExtra baggage: $50 each. Travel insurance: $30/passenger (enables full refund for health/weather cancellations). Do not add bags the user did not request.\n\n### Modify Flight\n\nObtain user id and reservation id first. Basic economy flights cannot have flights changed. Other reservations can change flights without altering origin, destination, or trip type. Cabin must remain the same across all flights; changing cabin for one segment only is not allowed. Cabin cannot be changed if any flight has already been flown. Price difference is charged or refunded accordingly. User can add but not remove checked bags. Insurance cannot be added after booking. Passenger info can be modified but not the number of passengers.\n\n### Cancel Flight\n\nObtain user id, reservation id, and cancellation reason (change of plan / airline cancelled / other). If any portion has already been flown, transfer to human. Otherwise, cancellation is allowed if any of: booking within last 24hrs, airline cancelled, business cabin, or user has travel insurance covering the reason. Refund goes to original payment methods within 5–7 business days.\n\nThe API does not enforce cancellation or modification rules — the agent must verify them before calling.\n\n### Refunds and Compensation\n\nDo not proactively offer compensation unless the user asks. Do not compensate regular members with no travel insurance flying (basic) economy. Always confirm facts first.\n\nEligible: silver/gold members, travel insurance holders, business cabin flyers.\n- Cancelled flight: offer certificate = $100 × number of passengers.\n- Delayed flight (if user changes or cancels): offer certificate = $50 × number of passengers.\n\nDo not offer compensation for any other reason.\n\n---\n\n## Available Tools\n\nAll methods are on `AirlineTools`. Call them as `tools.<method>(...)`.\n\n### READ\n\n**`get_user_details(user_id: str)`**\nFetch user profile and reservations. Example: `tools.get_user_details('sara_doe_496')`\n\n**`get_reservation_details(reservation_id: str)`**\nFetch a reservation by ID. Example: `tools.get_reservation_details('ZFA04Y')`\n\n**`get_flight_status(flight_number: str, date: str)`**\nGet flight status on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `tools.get_flight_status('AA123', '2024-05-20')`\n\n**`search_direct_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch direct flights. Origin/destination are IATA codes. Example: `tools.search_direct_flight('JFK', 'LAX', '2024-05-20')`"}}

{'id': '9789bf38', 'parent_ids': [], 'type': 'Tool Call', 'content': {'tool_name': 'read_file', 'tool_arguments': {'arg_0': 'skills/tau2Airline/src/tau2/domains/airline/policy.md', 'grep_pattern': '(?i)gold|baggage|bag|member|loyalty|tier|cancel|refund|compensat|insurance|upgrade'}, 'tool_output': '5|As an airline agent, you can help users **book**, **modify**, or **cancel** flight reservations. You also handle **refunds and compensation**.\n7|Before taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.\n26|- membership level\n31|There are three membership levels: **regular**, **silver**, **gold**.\n58|- baggages\n59|- travel insurance information\n79|- The remaining amount of a travel certificate is not refundable. \n82|Checked bag allowance: \n83|- If the booking user is a regular member:\n84|  - 0 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger\n85|  - 1 free checked bag for each economy passenger\n86|  - 2 free checked bags for each business passenger\n87|- If the booking user is a silver member:\n88|  - 1 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger\n89|  - 2 free checked bag for each economy passenger\n90|  - 3 free checked bags for each business passenger\n91|- If the booking user is a gold member:\n92|  - 2 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger\n93|  - 3 free checked bag for each economy passenger\n94|  - 4 free checked bags for each business passenger\n95|- Each extra baggage is 50 dollars.\n97|Do not add checked bags that the user does not need.\n99|Travel insurance: \n100|- The agent should ask if the user wants to buy the travel insurance.\n101|- The travel insurance is 30 dollars per passenger and enables full refund if the user needs to cancel the flight given health or weather reasons.\n120|- If the price after cabin change is lower than the original price, the user is should be refunded the difference.\n122|Change baggage and insurance: \n123|- The user can add but not remove checked bags.\n124|- The user cannot add insurance after initial booking.\n131|- If the flights are changed, the user needs to provide a single gift card or credit card for payment or refund method. The payment method must already be in user profile for safety reasons.\n133|## Cancel flight\n139|The agent must also obtain the reason for cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons)\n143|Otherwise, flight can be cancelled if any of the following is true:\n145|- The flight is cancelled by airline\n147|- The user has travel insurance and the reason for cancellation is covered by insurance.\n149|The API does not check that cancellation rules are met, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!\n151|Refund:\n152|- The refund will go to original payment methods within 5 to 7 business days.\n154|## Refunds and Compensation\n155|Do not proactively offer a compensation unless the user explicitly asks for one.\n157|Do not compensate if the user is regular member and has no travel insurance and flies (basic) economy.\n159|Always confirms the facts before offering compensation.\n161|Only compensate if the user is a silver/gold member or has travel insurance or flies business.\n163|- If the user complains about cancelled flights in a reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts, with the amount being $100 times the number of passengers.\n165|- If the user complains about delayed flights in a reservation and wants to change or cancel the reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts and changing or cancelling the reservation, with the amount being $50 times the number of passengers.\n167|Do not offer compensation for any other reason than the ones listed above.'}}
